pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 SENTENCES: SIMPLE SENTENCES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the role of sentences in a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify simple sentences from varied texts
2. construct simple sentences on a variety of issues

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify simple sentences from varied texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify simple sentences from varied texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. construct simple sentences on a variety of issues
   In simple words: practise until you can construct simple sentences on a variety of issues. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences.
4. Show that you can: identify simple sentences from varied texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Simple Sentences important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen keenly to a poem or a story on land travel and write down all the simple sentences that feature in the texts,
2. Collaborate with peers to read a print or non-print text on land travel and identify the simple sentences,
3. Complete a mind map to practise the construction of simple sentences,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of sentences in a text?
2. What constitutes a simple sentence?
3. How do you determine what to include in a sentence?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify simple sentences from varied texts
2. construct simple sentences on a variety of issues

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
